name: Showing Hand
description: Show the open hand and strike with it at once so the foe has nothing to guess about.

name: Honest Guard
description: Set a guard that shows its edges plainly and still turns a cut because it is placed exactly.

name: Direct Step
description: Step in a straight line at the foe with no weaving and no change of rhythm.

name: Candid Reading
description: Read a foe's stance as it really is and note where the weight sits in it.

name: Straight Jab
description: Snap a short jab straight down the centre line at the speed of the shoulder.

name: Level Look
description: Hold a level gaze on the foe and let it steady the arms and the nerve.

name: Telling Blow
description: Throw a blow whose force is exactly what it seems and cannot be fooled by a feint.

name: Unadorned Ward
description: Stand in a plain ward with no show or flourish that takes blows exactly where they come.

name: Dissolve Touch
description: Touch a thin illusion with the fingertips and let it come apart like wet paper.

name: Glare Break
description: Break a false glare of qi with a flat clap of the hands.

name: Seeing Palm
description: Strike the true body behind an image after reading where it really stands.

name: False Guard
description: Ignore a false limb and turn aside only the one that carries weight.

name: Echo Test
description: Send a ping of clear qi and judge by its return whether a shape is flesh or fiction.

name: Befuddle Lift
description: Touch the brow of an ally and clear the haze of a charm or a fear from his mind.

name: Veil Rend
description: Rend a wide veil of illusion with a sweep of the arm and leave the ground plain.

name: Tremor Sense
description: Hold still and feel for the faint tremor in the air that follows a spoken lie.

name: Pulse Check
description: Rest a hand on a speaker's wrist and note how the pulse answers each claim.

name: Level Palm
description: Strike with a flat level palm that arrives where the sense said the foe would be.

name: Sure Guard
description: Raise a guard on the single line the sense has marked as true.

name: Proven Step
description: Step onto the ground the sense has judged safe and away from the false footing.

name: Doubt Seed
description: Say one true fact aloud that shakes a foe's belief in the lie he leans on.

name: Lie Sense
description: Spread the lie sense over a room and mark every speaker whose words and qi disagree.

name: Mark of Falsehood
description: Leave a faint mark on the one who lied and follow it by sense as he moves.

name: Truth Pressure
description: Lean on a foe with the plain weight of what is so until his bluster gives way.

name: Plight Showing
description: Show a foe in a flash how the fight really stands and let the shock slow his hands.

name: Hard Fact
description: Land a blow no clever guard can wish away.

name: Fact Shield
description: Stand behind a wall of plain fact that the foe's tricks cannot talk past.

name: Reckoning Step
description: Step in at the exact moment the foe's own claims about his position fail him.

name: Face Facts
description: Hold a foe's gaze and force him to see the truth of his wounds and his odds.

name: Pretence Fall
description: Take away the foe's pretence of strength until he stands bare and cannot lift his guard.
